agent_notes: The institution is listed exactly in the supplied NIRF 2025 Overall government directory row for Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

The normal TLS request first returned the exact managed-proxy self-signed certificate-chain error; public GETs were then retried with curl --insecure only for the expected public hosts www.nirfindia.org, dsmru.up.nic.in and dsmnru.ac.in.

dsmnru.ac.in is treated as an additional official domain because the official dsmru.up.nic.in site links to it for university admission material, while dsmnru.ac.in links back to dsmru.up.nic.in as About University.

The catalogue is distributed across the official 2026-27 UG and PG prospectuses and the latest official Ph.D. prospectus for session 2025-26; affiliated-college programme entries and expired notices were excluded.
Career mappings were read from assets/data/career_path.db with sqlite3 read-only queries; the database was not edited.
